proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6507.2 *dēkṣati explicitly gives Ashokan dekhati, Prakrit dekkhaï, Bhojpuri dēkhal, Hindi dekhnā and Sindhi ḍekhaṇu. The e-vowel and kh select branch 2. The article describes geographical spread; intra-IA transmission is left open. Compound verbs and contracted forms without diagnostic kh are excluded.
